10266|6e63d362.name: Ug'thok
10266|6e63d362.text: You learn quickly, that is not a bad thing. Just be sure to do the job right, as long as it takes to do so. Now, I fear I must send you to Snarl to learn more. Learn what he can teach, but do not listen to his angry words. He gets that way when Saru's daughters laugh at him.

10378|4fa5b9c3.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|4fa5b9c3.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

11046|28b8dee2.name: Whuut
11046|28b8dee2.text: Why should I pace myself if this is working?

11046|6253ba70.name: Whuut
11046|6253ba70.text: All the bottles on this table are potions I brewed today. And they say a watched pot never boils. Ha!

11176|f7f357cc.name: Krathok Moltenfist
11176|f7f357cc.text: I am Krathok, overseer of these craftsmen.

11870|3a5c3d7e.name: Archibald
11870|3a5c3d7e.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

11870|d4580704.name: Archibald
11870|d4580704.text:
Sayoc is the $r weapon master.  He is located in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.  He can train the use of bows, daggers, fist weapons, one and two-handed axes and thrown weapons.

Hanashi, the troll weapon master in the Valley of Honor of Orgrimmar, can instruct in the use of bows, one and two-handed axes, staves and all thrown weapons.

Ansekhwa, the tauren weapon master, is on Thunder Bluff's lower rise.  He teaches the use of one and two-handed maces, staves and guns.

1383|da72a588.name: Snarl
1383|da72a588.text: So you think you are good enough to learn from me? The great Snarl? You are no more than a lowly worm beneath my boot. However, taking on an underling might make me seem more appealing to Sumi and Tumi. Let's see what meager skills you possess.

14392|9edd139f.name: Overlord Runthak
14392|9edd139f.text: I am he that carries out the Warchief's commands without question. I am Horde.

14728|9cac81e8.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
14728|9cac81e8.text:
Hail brother... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.

We tauren have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of tauren everywhere in helping us out!

1500|2af9e51a.name: Coleman Farthing
1500|2af9e51a.text:
I hope you're well, all things considered.

Sit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!

1518|173903a2.name: Apothecary Johaan
1518|173903a2.text: The Dark Lady has put forth the challenge.  It is up to us to meet it.

15350|44b49612.name: Horde Warbringer
15350|44b49612.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

1952|7327dd7a.name: High Executor Hadrec
1952|7327dd7a.text: Hello, $C.  If you're here, then you must know that Silverpine is saturated with our enemies.  To survive, the Forsaken must drive them back!

2131|ed01dd60.name: Austil de Mon
2131|ed01dd60.text: The $c's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

248202|055d4e51.name: Jim'bek
248202|055d4e51.text:
<Jim'bek locks eyes with you as he takes a deep puff from his hookah.>

'Ello, mon. Need a rug? A blanket? Or just some cloth for your next project? I got you.

256386|6a190ff9.name: Dokimi
256386|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256388|13e9970d.name: Jornah
256388|13e9970d.text:
Greetings and well met, $N! Your arrival is timely, and we here at the Durotar Supply and Logistics company are always in need of new contractors.

If you are someone with a knack for gathering useful materials or the skills to craft something from scratch, you have a place here.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

257003|1a6886aa.name: Ishlee Breezewhisper
257003|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

262502|3e8465bb.name: Brix Xizzix
262502|3e8465bb.text: When I heard that there was a whole new gaggle of elves literally fallin' from the sky, I said to myself "THAT'S where I need to be". A whole new society of impressionable, bright-eyed suckers... er--customers!

262558|996eca9b.name: Palah Thunderhoof
262558|996eca9b.text: May the spirits be with you.

263646|53fff4bc.name: Rugbul Boomfirst
263646|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

263647|fb408f08.name: Borook Gallfist
263647|fb408f08.text: Well, well... are you ready to fight for the Horde in Darkspear Islands?

267009|6f316d7a.name: Hadric Harlson
267009|6f316d7a.text: Be careful, $c. There are cultists nearby.

2704|15da2919.name: Hanashi
2704|15da2919.text: Heya mon.  You come right place learn how ta wield a new weapon.

270582|e6b98502.name: Mon'ye
270582|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

275270|56f11671.name: Windshapers Dockmaster
275270|56f11671.text: This skycutter will take you right to the wondrous open plains of Mulgore.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3004|dfa12b04.name: Tepa
3004|dfa12b04.text: You are truly a determined student. I will be happy to provide you with instruction!

3084|2d9bad33.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|2d9bad33.text: And to which battleground do you wish to journey?

3084|4f8156cd.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|4f8156cd.text: Clothing the tribe is as important a job as any other.  You should look for Tepa inside Thunder Bluff Armorers.  She has a natural way with the needle.

3084|5092cb45.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|5092cb45.text: Tepa is renown for her clothwork.  She can be found at Thunder Bluff Armorers on the middle rise.

3084|72077a95.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|72077a95.text: You may shed yourself of your worldly possessions at the Thunder Bluff Bank on the lower rise.

3084|73a86360.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|73a86360.text: Brek Stonehoof can be found at Stonehoof Geology on the lower rise and can teach you the proper way to harvest precious ores and gems.

3084|ea04b75c.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|ea04b75c.text: The Earth Mother holds many secrets and Brek Stonehoof can help you to discover some of them.  You will find him on the lower rise at Stonehoof Geology.

3139|82bfeb72.name: Gar'Thok
3139|82bfeb72.text: Throm'ka, $c. There is little time for talk and much work to be done.

3142|99ae9589.name: Orgnil Soulscar
3142|99ae9589.text: Hail.  Be brief, for we both have much to do.

3169|640f312b.name: Tarshaw Jaggedscar
3169|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a $c's time.

3174|cb2b8cd1.name: Dwukk
3174|cb2b8cd1.text: Just swinging a hammer at an anvil doesn't make you a smith. Give me that and let me teach you something before you embarrass us all.

3188|366172e1.name: Master Gadrin
3188|366172e1.text: There is something you wish to discuss, $c... come, sit by me.

3191|0c543544.name: Cook Torka
3191|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3230|8d5031bd.name: Nazgrel
3230|8d5031bd.text: Mind yourself in the presence of the Warchief, $c. The Kor'kron will suffer no insolence or insult here.

3293|5bfb096f.name: Rezlak
3293|5bfb096f.text: I'm happy Gazlowe gave me the opportunity to be here and all, but this place is more dangerous than I thought it'd be. It's also really hot. And dusty. And it smells kinda weird. Ah, well! Hopefully it will be good for business.

3296|2213d915.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|2213d915.text: Talk to Saru Steelfury at The Burning Anvil.  Go to the Valley of Honor.  It's at the end of the path to the right of Red Canyon Mining.

3296|5516f117.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|5516f117.text: In the Cleft of Shadow Kor'ghan is waiting with shears sharper than a guard's sword.

3296|adf2f562.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|adf2f562.text: Looking to learn how to use a new weapon?  Find Sayoc and Hanashi inside Arms of Legend in the Valley of Honor.

3296|b5e5cb59.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|b5e5cb59.text: Look for Sayoc and Hanashi at the Valley of Honor inside Arms of Legend.  Watch your tongue around them or Sayoc may decide to give a piece of you as a snack to Grinning Dog.

3296|c0e82349.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|c0e82349.text: Go to the cleft of shadow and seek out Spellweaver Mon'ye there, near the center of the district.

3296|ce1ceb20.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|ce1ceb20.text: Speak to Grezz Ragefist in the Hall of the Brave, which is in the Valley of Honor.  Put in a good word for me!

3304|645294fc.name: Master Vornal
3304|645294fc.text: The sands of Durotar are tough and dry compared to the tropical and lush lands we're from, but we Darkspear persevere. Where chief Vol'jin leads, we will follow.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3314|1676cade.name: Urtharo
3314|1676cade.text: Tell me what you want, and make it quick.

3314|8fd1ef50.name: Urtharo
3314|8fd1ef50.text: So many years of battle and slavery, it feels good to have a home again.

3320|2f8d506f.name: Soran
3320|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3320|6b36598f.name: Soran
3320|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3320|ae78a458.name: Soran
3320|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3332|51d936f4.name: Lumak
3332|51d936f4.text: Fish so delicious. You come learn fish? Eat fish? Mmmmm...

3347|9cc6e14a.name: Yelmak
3347|9cc6e14a.text: I'm busy, $N. Tell Whuut to handle whatever it is. That young pup has been stewing all day long. He spends much more time like that, and he's going to hurt something.

3353|640f312b.name: Grezz Ragefist
3353|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a $c's time.

3354|640f312b.name: Sorek
3354|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a $c's time.

3355|9ce36f55.name: Saru Steelfury
3355|9ce36f55.text: This isn't a game you toy with youngling! Go, speak with Snarl outside. He may be a serpent in my lair but he does know his way around an anvil.

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3373|1355f2b7.name: Arnok
3373|1355f2b7.text: I am an $r of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

3408|08e320c2.name: Zel'mak
3408|08e320c2.text: What kin I do for ya, mon?

3413|c879b3f9.name: Sovik
3413|c879b3f9.text: Hello, $N! If you don't see it in my shop, chances are good I can get it!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4595|ed01dd60.name: Baltus Fowler
4595|ed01dd60.text: The $c's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5941|c2467ddc.name: Lau'Tiki
5941|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

5943|a28d29e1.name: Rawrk
5943|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

5953|ba9f567e.name: Razor Hill Grunt
5953|ba9f567e.text: Find Tarshaw Jaggedscar inside the barracks on the east side of Razor Hill.  Bring pride and honor to the Horde youngling!

5953|bdc73c0f.name: Razor Hill Grunt
5953|bdc73c0f.text: There's one of those inside the barracks on the east side of Razor Hill.  Look for Rawrk.

5953|f9e03ef4.name: Razor Hill Grunt
5953|f9e03ef4.text: Look for Tarshaw Jaggedscar in the barracks on the east side of town.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6746|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Pala
6746|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6928|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Grosk
6928|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7230|d65bcdb0.name: Shayis Steelfury
7230|d65bcdb0.text: I don't train smiths with no skill, come back when you have something decent to show me.

7231|248686cb.name: Kelgruk Bloodaxe
7231|248686cb.text: What is it? Can't you see I'm busy?

7427|090f8855.name: Taim Ragetotem
7427|090f8855.text: Our forces in Alterac Valley need wisdom to achieve victory $c.  You look like the one to lead them.

7953|a3eec9a8.name: Xar'Ti
7953|a3eec9a8.text: You need to be exalted with the trolls of the Darkspear tribe before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

1096-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-progress.text: Sputtervalve will want some sort of proof that Gerenzo's dead. I think his mechanical arm will probably do.
1096-progress.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1102-progress.name: Auld Stonespire
1102-progress.text:
Once I know the foul beasts of Razorfen Kraul have been driven from their foul lair, I will be able to rest in peace, knowing that revenge has been served.

Have you the driven the quilboar from the Kraul? Do you bring to me good news in the form of Razorflank's heart?
1102-progress.title: A Vengeful Fate

1498-progress.name: Uzzek
1498-progress.text: Do you have the scales, $N?  Unless you can withstand the attacks of the thunder lizards, you will not benefit from my instruction.
1498-progress.title: Path of Defense

404-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-progress.text: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
404-progress.title: A Putrid Task

445-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-progress.text: What business do you have with me, $c?
445-progress.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

513-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-progress.text: Can you not see I am busy, $c?  The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us.  And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity.  This better be important!
513-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

529-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-progress.text: Were you able to carry out your orders, $c?  Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants?  And where is that iron shipment?
529-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

546-progress.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-progress.text:
So the lucky $N returns?  How many humans have you slaughtered today?  Hundreds I do hope!

Have you any skulls for me?
546-progress.title: Souvenirs of Death

5881-progress.name: Grish Longrunner
5881-progress.text: You have news from Maggran Earthbinder?
5881-progress.title: Calling in the Reserves

6283-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6283-progress.text:
Bloodfury Ripper is a nasty creature! You will have success finding her along the western hill line in the Charred Vale.

The bloodfuries will be helpless with out... surely we can vanquish them forever!
6283-progress.title: Bloodfury Bloodline

6381-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-progress.text:
These seeds you plant are strong, resisting corruption, and making a foothold for other life. They will grow and grow, first preventing corruption and healing the scarred land, and then one day, restoring Stonetalon to a lush forest, once again.

Have you planted all of the Gaea seeds?
6381-progress.title: New Life

6393-progress.name: Tsunaman
6393-progress.text: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?
6393-progress.title: Elemental War

6571-progress.name: Locke Okarr
6571-progress.text: I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!
6571-progress.title: Warsong Supplies

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

815-progress.name: Cook Torka
815-progress.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!
815-progress.title: Break a Few Eggs

834-progress.name: Rezlak
834-progress.text: I'm great at what I do, don't get me wrong, but this is ridiculous! What am I supposed to do, build sand castles?
834-progress.title: Winds in the Desert

86576-progress.name: Mor'rogal
86576-progress.text: I have important matters to consider, $c. Be quick.
86576-progress.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

91904-progress.name: Dokimi
91904-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

95663-complete.name: Deathstalker Agent
95663-complete.text: These are the courageous few? Mind your voices.
95663-complete.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95664-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-progress.text: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
95664-progress.title: Elder Knowledge

95682-progress.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-progress.text: We're here to get the important job done. If you can help, prove it.
95682-progress.title: Open the Maw

95697-progress.name: Borstan
95697-progress.text: Farm-raised boar, farm-raised crawler... what's next, farm-raised raptor?
95697-progress.title: Changing Tastes

96241-progress.name: Mazu'kon
96241-progress.text: Did ya get what I need?
96241-progress.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96260-progress.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-progress.text: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
96260-progress.title: Stronger than Steel

97282-progress.name: Rezlak
97282-progress.text:
It might come as a surprise that with a name like thunder lizard they shoot lightning instead of roaring like thunder.

Well, they do. Shoot lightning, I mean.

Trust me, it's a lesson you only get to learn once if you're lucky.
97282-progress.title: Stormy Potential

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests

99196-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99196-progress.text:
The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99196-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
